# Results -- Study 222 (Altseason-Rotation) on real daily panel

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). One recipe -- use falling
BTC dominance (BTC's share of total basket market cap, proxied from price x fixed supply)
to time a long-alt/short-BTC rotation strategy. Two signal variants tested on BTC + 6
major alts (2020-04-10 to 2026-06-16). Transaction costs applied at 40 bps round-trip
per rotation event. As-of **2026-06-16**; match the fingerprint below to confirm you hold
the same panel.*

## The rotation strategy results

### Signal 1: dom_change_20d (20-day dominance change, threshold = -2 pp)

Fires when BTC basket dominance has fallen >= 2 percentage points over the past 20 trading
days. Positions: long equal-weighted alts, short BTC. Exit when next signal day fires 0.

| Arm | Ann. Return | Ann. Vol | Sharpe | HAC t-stat | Max Drawdown |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **Gross (40 bps RT)** | +13.48% | 21.16% | **0.64** | **+1.48** | -66.46% |
| **Net (40 bps RT)** | +9.64% | 21.26% | **0.45** | **+1.05** | -89.26% |
| Net (80 bps RT, stress) | +5.82% | 21.36% | 0.27 | +0.63 | -89.26% |

Rotation events: **43** in 6 years, average hold = **7.3 days**, active **13.8%** of days.

### Signal 2: dom_level (below 52-week rolling median)

Active when BTC basket dominance is below its trailing 1-year median -- a structural
low-dominance regime.

| Arm | Ann. Return | Ann. Vol | Sharpe | HAC t-stat | Max Drawdown |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **Gross (40 bps RT)** | +7.36% | 28.79% | **0.26** | **+0.67** | -76.63% |
| **Net (40 bps RT)** | +4.24% | 28.79% | **0.15** | **+0.38** | -101.83% |

Rotation events: **35** in 6 years, average hold = **23.9 days**, active **37.1%** of days.

### Benchmarks (buy-and-hold)

| Benchmark | Ann. Return | Sharpe |
|---|--:|--:|
| BTC buy-and-hold | +25.33% | **0.53** |
| Equal-weight alts buy-and-hold | +33.47% | **0.51** |
| Always long alt-minus-BTC spread | +8.15% | 0.20 (t = +0.57) |

## Key findings

- **No variant clears the |t| >= 2 bar.** Best result is the dom_change_20d gross
  strategy at t = +1.48, dropping to t = +1.05 net of costs. Neither clears the
  inference bar.
- **The strategy underperforms buy-and-hold.** Net Sharpe of 0.45 (dom_change_20d)
  is below BTC's Sharpe of 0.53 and alt EW's 0.51. The rotation timing adds no
  detectable alpha over the simpler benchmarks.
- **Always-long-spread is itself weak.** The unconditional long-alt/short-BTC spread
  earns +8.15%/yr at Sharpe 0.20 and t = +0.57. The dominance-timed version cannot
  beat this already weak baseline.
- **Max drawdowns are severe.** The 40 bps scenario gives -89% MDD for the net
  dom_change strategy, reflecting the concentration of losses in the 2022 bear market
  when both BTC and alts crashed and the spread blew out.
- **Verdict: Signal = None, Tradability = Mirage.** Not WEAK because the HAC t-stats
  are materially below 1.5 on the net returns, the strategy fails to beat simpler
  benchmarks, and the single-cycle sample offers no evidence of repeatable regime
  discrimination. The gross t of 1.48 is before survivorship adjustment; the net
  numbers confirm the edge is illusory.

## Synthetic positive control

On a deterministic synthetic panel (`data.synthetic_daily`), the same engine recovers a
dominance->rotation edge only when one is explicitly planted (dom_signal > 0):

| Planted dom_signal | Net Sharpe | t-stat (net) | Signal found? |
|---|--:|--:|:---:|
| 0.0 (null) | ~0.10 | ~0.3 | no |
| 1.0 | > 0.60 | > 2.0 | yes |
| 2.0 | > 1.20 | > 3.0 | yes |

The engine is a faithful rotation-strategy detector; the real tape simply has no
detectable timing edge.

## Verdict

- **Signal -- NONE.** Net t-stats below 1.1 on all variants; strategy underperforms
  buy-and-hold. No inference bar cleared.
- **Tradability -- MIRAGE.** Net Sharpe 0.45 (best case) is below BTC buy-and-hold
  Sharpe 0.53; 80-bps stress case is 0.27. Severe drawdowns (-89%) make this
  unimplementable. Transaction costs are modest but the gross edge is too thin to
  survive them reliably.
- **Alt-season timing? -- BUSTED as a strategy.** BTC dominance does not produce a
  reliable timing signal for a long-alt/short-BTC rotation over one crypto cycle.
  The narrative is a coincident description of the 2021 alt season, not a repeatable
  forecast rule.
